scenarios.description: A cheaper compatible candidate passes every deterministic assertion and hard limit.
scenarios.expectedReason: Quality is non-inferior and estimated cost is lower.
assertions: Recommendation cites the immutable catalog snapshot.
A minimal model-literal patch is produced.

scenarios.description: The candidate returns invalid JSON for a call site with a JSON output contract.
scenarios.expectedReason: A deterministic output-contract assertion failed.
assertions: No patch is produced.
The failed eval case is reported.

scenarios.description: The candidate omits a human-reviewed protected segment.
scenarios.expectedReason: A protected-segment assertion failed.
assertions: The protected value is not exposed in logs.
No recommendation is emitted.

scenarios.description: The suite has too few passing representative cases to meet the confidence policy.
scenarios.expectedReason: The minimum evidence threshold was not met.
assertions: The report identifies the missing evidence.
No patch is produced.

scenarios.description: A sufficiently large representative suite produces mutually contradictory deterministic outcomes.
scenarios.expectedReason: The evidence is contradictory and cannot support a non-inferiority conclusion.
assertions: The report identifies the conflicting outcomes.
No recommendation or patch is produced.

scenarios.description: A cheaper model does not support the call site's required tool semantics.
scenarios.expectedReason: Candidate capabilities do not satisfy hard compatibility constraints.
assertions: The candidate is excluded before evaluation.
The exclusion reason is deterministic.

scenarios.description: A dynamic application wrapper prevents high-confidence extraction of the semantic call site.
scenarios.expectedReason: Discovery confidence is below the patch threshold.
assertions: The finding is reported as ambiguous.
No manifest or source file is modified.

scenarios.description: The source changed after discovery, invalidating the scanner fingerprint.
scenarios.expectedReason: The patch precondition no longer matches the source.
assertions: No stale patch is applied.
A rescan is requested.

scenarios.description: An archived run is replayed after the live provider catalog changes.
scenarios.expectedReason: Replay uses the checked-in immutable catalog snapshot.
assertions: Candidate ordering is unchanged.
Price calculations are unchanged.

scenarios.description: More than five compatible models are available and the repository does not override the default candidate bound.
scenarios.expectedReason: The locked catalog ranking tuple produces the same default-five shortlist.
assertions: The baseline is recorded separately from exactly five candidates.
The pinned representative usage profile has prompt weight 9 and completion weight 1 with reviewed fixture provenance.

The compatible fixture tuples (prompt price, completion price, context) are mock/alpha=(0.1,10.0,32768), mock/bravo=(1.0,2.0,65536), mock/charlie=(1.0,2.0,65536), mock/delta=(1.0,2.0,32768), mock/echo=(1.2,1.0,131072), mock/foxtrot=(0.2,10.2,131072), and mock/golf=(2.0,0.1,131072).
The exact-decimal projected workload costs are alpha=10.9, bravo=11.0, charlie=11.0, delta=11.0, echo=11.8, foxtrot=12.0, and golf=18.1.
The ordered candidate IDs are mock/alpha, mock/bravo, mock/charlie, mock/delta, and mock/echo.
The pinned catalog ranks projected workload cost ascending, context limit descending, then canonical model ID ascending.
Models outside the shortlist are not executed.

scenarios.description: Repository policy requests a candidate limit greater than the V1 maximum of five.
scenarios.expectedReason: The configured candidate limit exceeds the supported maximum.
assertions: Configuration fails validation.
No candidate model is executed.

scenarios.description: More than two compatible models are available and repository policy lowers the candidate limit to two.
scenarios.expectedReason: The valid lower repository bound truncates the locked ranked shortlist.
assertions: The baseline is recorded separately from exactly two candidates.
The ordered candidate IDs are mock/alpha and mock/bravo.
Models outside the two-candidate shortlist are not executed.

scenarios.description: A live refresh returns catalog content identical to the latest normalized snapshot.
scenarios.expectedReason: The normalized content digest is unchanged, so the immutable snapshot is reused.
assertions: No duplicate snapshot is created.
A new immutable refresh observation records source, observation time, and normalized content digest and references the reused snapshot.
The refresh observation cannot change historical replay.

scenarios.description: The live OpenRouter catalog refresh fails while an older snapshot exists locally.
scenarios.expectedReason: Current catalog state could not be established.
assertions: The older snapshot remains available only for explicit replay.
No prior snapshot is represented as current and no patch is produced.

scenarios.description: The mock provider returns rate limits until the deterministic retry and budget limits are exhausted.
scenarios.expectedReason: Execution could not collect sufficient evidence within policy limits.
assertions: Retry count is bounded.
No partial result is promoted to a recommendation.

scenarios.description: The GitHub Action is rerun with unchanged inputs after a complete, integrity-valid recommendation whose policy permits reuse.
scenarios.expectedReason: Identical inputs and reusable prior evidence preserve artifacts without duplicate execution or PR output.
assertions: Artifact digests match.
The existing recommendation identity is reused.
No paid candidate execution occurs.

scenarios.description: A prior rate-limited run exhausted its retry budget, then an unchanged-input rerun occurs after the mock provider recovers.
scenarios.expectedReason: Incomplete exhausted evidence is not reusable and cannot suppress a later bounded retry.
assertions: Candidates execute again within the configured retry, timeout, and spend limits.
The failed run remains immutable and is not reused as current evidence.
The successful rerun receives a new run and evidence identity.

scenarios.description: A completed recommendation has unchanged input digests, but its cached evidence no longer matches its recorded integrity digest.
scenarios.expectedReason: Integrity-invalid evidence is not reusable and cannot suppress a bounded reevaluation.
assertions: The corrupted evidence remains immutable, is flagged integrity-invalid, and is not reused as current.
Candidates execute again within the configured retry, timeout, and spend limits.
The successful reevaluation receives a new run and evidence identity.

scenarios.description: Source, manifest, fixtures, and catalog are unchanged but a deterministic scorer threshold changes.
scenarios.expectedReason: The scorer-policy change produces a new evaluation-input digest.
assertions: Candidate evaluation runs again within the configured budget.
A new run and evidence identity is produced.
Prior recommendation evidence is not reused as current.

scenarios.description: Source, manifest, fixtures, catalog, and scorer policy are unchanged but relevant execution configuration changes.
scenarios.expectedReason: The execution-configuration change produces a new evaluation-input digest.
assertions: Candidate evaluation runs again within the new limits.
A new run and evidence identity is produced.
Prior recommendation evidence is not reused as current.

scenarios.description: Repository inputs, catalog, scorer policy, and execution configuration are unchanged but the evaluator tool version or build revision changes.
scenarios.expectedReason: The evaluator executable identity change produces a new evaluation-input digest.
assertions: Candidate evaluation runs again within the configured limits.
The new evidence records the updated tool version and build or commit revision.
A new run and evidence identity is produced and prior evidence is not reused as current.

scenarios.description: Source, manifest, fixtures, and catalog are changed one at a time while every other evaluation input remains fixed.
scenarios.expectedReason: Each independently changed repository input produces a new evaluation-input digest.
assertions: A source fingerprint change invalidates reuse and creates a new run and evidence identity.
A call-site manifest digest change invalidates reuse and creates a new run and evidence identity.
An eval-fixture digest change invalidates reuse and creates a new run and evidence identity.
A normalized catalog content digest change invalidates reuse and creates a new run and evidence identity.
Each subcase executes candidates again within the configured limits.

scenarios.description: A scheduled provider-backed assessment is attempted without explicit repository opt-in.
scenarios.expectedReason: Provider-backed scheduling is disabled by default.
assertions: No provider call occurs.
No GitHub write occurs.

scenarios.description: Repository policy explicitly enables a scheduled provider-backed assessment with candidate, spend, retry, and timeout limits.
scenarios.expectedReason: Explicit schedule consent permits the bounded assessment to run.
assertions: The mock provider receives only the bounded candidate calls.
Evidence records schedule consent and every execution limit.
No permission is granted beyond assessment and the configured draft-PR mode.

scenarios.description: Fixtures contain sentinel credentials and sensitive model-output markers.
scenarios.expectedReason: Reports and logs retain only approved summaries and hashes.
assertions: Sentinel credentials never appear in output.
Raw protected model output never appears in output.
